title: Unreal Engine pack
description: Just-in-time UE pack (discovery, asset safety, validation layers) and Unreal C++ defaults; for Claude Code also a path-scoped rule for *.h/*.cpp/*.inl.
postInstall: Unreal pack installed in ~/.agents/instructions (unreal-engine.md, unreal-cpp.md); ROUTER.md loads it when a .uproject is in play. With Claude Code, ~/.claude/rules/unreal-cpp.md loads when a C++ file is read or edited and points to the pack (other tools, such as Grok, load that pointer in every session, so it stays a few lines). Put your team's own C++ standards in the project instructions; they take precedence.
